## Description

Buys shortly before ex-dividend date and exits after the event, attempting to capture dividend income net of the price adjustment and trading costs.

## Where it may fit

Only if taxes, microstructure or other frictions produce a demonstrable net anomaly; not a simple free-dividend trade.

## Vehicles

Equity income, short-horizon event trading and dividend-focused accounts.

## Required data

Ex-dividend/pay dates, dividend amount, price history, taxes/withholding, bid-ask spreads and corporate-action records.

## Caveats

Prices typically adjust around ex-dividend dates; taxes, spreads and opportunity cost often overwhelm gross dividend yield.
